svg.title: Barcode verification report comparison checklist
svg.desc: Check symbol, measurement setup, sample identity and acceptance scope before comparing reports.

g.text: Compare the report, not just the grade
Editorial checklist · not a verification method
Type, encoded data, dimensions and use.
Method, aperture and illumination as reported.
Ask a qualified verifier to interpret them.
Artwork, construction, production lot and date.
Identify how it represents the delivered stock.
Criteria, grade, test scope and unresolved gaps.
A single sample does not certify a whole lot.
A successful scan is a different observation.
